model_metadata_verification: Exact deployment digests reused from the same-day pagination whole-file plan, where Ollama /api/tags verified them without model load or inference; every digest must be rechecked before execution

development_smoke.reason: The smoke outcome was observed before this comparison plan was frozen. Every deployment, including Ornith, receives a fresh post-freeze attempt.

order_method: Counterbalance the three distinct prior five-model order designs DBCEA, AEDBC and CABED. Require every alias to occupy a position it has not occupied in those designs; among the four feasible permutations, maximize total absolute position displacement from the latest design CABED, then use a lexicographic tie-break. The paired pagination v1.1 comparison intentionally reused CABED and is counted as the same order design, not a fourth design. The resulting authoritative order is EDACB.

methodology.generation_verification_boundary: Generate with deferred verification when local Ollama access requires elevation; execute candidate code only in the later workspace-sandbox command.

evaluation.cross_case_aggregation: Keep this result separate from pagination at task level; a later descriptive view may compare per-model verified outcomes across both cases without creating a universal composite score.

performance_interpretation: Wall time and Ollama timing fields are retained as exploratory cold-attempt diagnostics. One attempt per model does not estimate steady-state latency, latency tails or reliability distributions.
interpretation_limit: This is one development task and one post-freeze attempt per deployment. It can compare verified capability on this JavaScript async-state case but cannot establish general coding superiority, reliability, language-level capability or a minimum sufficient model.
